paragraphs.source_en: With the birth of Hideyori, Hidetsugu had become an obstacle in Hideyoshi’s path, a thorn in his side. From beginning to end he had been no more than a puppet—rebuked, praised, elevated, and crushed by Hideyoshi, helplessly branded a treacherous minister or rebel and manipulated at another’s whim.

units.source_en: From beginning to end he had been no more than a puppet—rebuked, praised, elevated, and crushed by Hideyoshi, helplessly branded a treacherous minister or rebel and manipulated at another’s whim.

paragraphs.source_zh: 随着秀赖的出生，秀次竟成了秀吉的绊脚石、眼中钉。他自始至终只是傀儡，被秀吉斥责、褒奖、推举、打压，身不由己地背上了逆臣或谋反的罪名，任人摆布。

paragraphs.source_en: Grinding his teeth, Hidetsugu looked around and discovered that all he was free to do was drink to excess and abuse women. At last he had entered hell and realized that uncle and nephew could not coexist. Hideyoshi was as savage as a jackal or wolf, cruel and merciless. His mighty achievements were purchased by devouring the happiness of his own kin; beneath the feet of this peerless tyrant lay countless corpses.
